summary.text: Tom Schamberg is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack 6 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House from 2012 to 2014, representing Merrimack 4.

paragraphs.text: Tom Schamberg first served in the New Hampshire House from 2012 to 2014, representing Merrimack 4, according to Ballotpedia.
His current tenure, representing Merrimack 6, began in 2018.
He served on the House Ways and Means Committee in the 2013 session, in 2019-2020, and in 2023-2024.
